name: @canvist/web
description: The canvist editor for the browser: a canvas that wraps text exactly like canvist's server-rendered HTML, with typed commands and a font plugin.

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:core && npm run build:wasm:collab && npm run build:wasm:full
scripts.build:wasm:core: cd ../.. && RUSTFLAGS="--cfg canvist_omit_docs" wasm-pack build crates/canvist_web --target web --profile wasm-web --no-opt --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-web/wasm --no-pack && rm packages/canvist-web/wasm/.gitignore && cd packages/canvist-web && node scripts/optimize-wasm.ts wasm/canvist_web_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:collab: cd ../.. && RUSTFLAGS="--cfg canvist_omit_docs" wasm-pack build crates/canvist_web --target web --profile wasm-web --no-opt --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-web/wasm-collab --no-pack -- --features collab && rm packages/canvist-web/wasm-collab/.gitignore && cd packages/canvist-web && node scripts/optimize-wasm.ts wasm-collab/canvist_web_bg.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:full: cd ../.. && RUSTFLAGS="--cfg canvist_omit_docs" wasm-pack build crates/canvist_web --target web --profile wasm-web --no-opt --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-web/wasm-full --no-pack -- --features full && rm packages/canvist-web/wasm-full/.gitignore && cd packages/canvist-web && node scripts/optimize-wasm.ts wasm-full/canvist_web_bg.wasm
scripts.size: vite build --config tests/bundle/vite.config.ts --logLevel error && node scripts/bundle-size.ts --budget 359000
